Privacy中的三个默认设置相互独立 / Inspect the three independent Privacy defaults
分别修改Authorization与Cookie默认值 / Change Authorization and Cookie defaults separately
原UI：Sidebar仍应用同一设置请求；Privacy连续点击只修改各自字段。 / Original UI: Sidebar uses the same preference request; consecutive Privacy clicks change only their own fields.
MCP：Agent撤权不影响独立Ask/Auto，审批拒绝无修改，允许后结果与页面一致。 / MCP: Agent revocation leaves independent Ask/Auto access; denial does not mutate settings and allowed results agree with the page.
打开HAR时读取当时的Privacy默认值 / An opened HAR draft uses the current Privacy defaults
默认值改变不改写已经打开的HAR草稿 / Changing defaults does not rewrite an open HAR draft
重新打开HAR读取新的默认值 / Reopening HAR reads the new defaults
关闭前核对保存的Privacy设置 / Inspect saved Privacy settings before closing
导出默认值：真实Capture使HAR选项可用，打开中的草稿保持原值，下次打开读取新偏好。 / Export defaults: real Capture enables HAR options; an open draft retains its values and the next draft reads the updated preferences.
在Collection中新建需要保留的请求 / Create a Collection request to retain
填写请求URL并等待自动保存，不发送 / Enter the URL for autosave without sending
填写保存请求的名称 / Name the saved request
关闭前的Capture记录仍是临时数据 / Capture records remain temporary before closing
保存后通过窗口Close正常退出 / Close the window normally after saving
重启后Privacy保持关闭前的设置 / Privacy retains its saved settings after restart
重启后Collection名称和URL保留且没有自动Send / The Collection name and URL survive restart without an automatic Send
重启后上一代临时Capture记录不再保留 / Temporary Capture records from the previous process are not retained
恢复原来的Privacy默认值和主题 / Restore the original Privacy defaults and theme

workflows.testName: settings.tools.system-proxy rejects overlapping Enable calls without a queue

steps.title: 检查已接管的系统代理及Restore入口 / Inspect owned system proxy and Restore
Restore后系统路由恢复，监听器继续运行 / Restore the system route while keeping the listener available
显式代理客户端在Restore后仍通过监听器 / An explicit proxy client still uses the listener after Restore
通过Enable重新接管系统代理 / Take ownership again through Enable
Enable后确认接管状态 / Confirm ownership after Enable
确认Recording已开启后再暂停 / Confirm Recording is active before pausing
单独暂停Recording / Pause Recording separately
暂停Recording不恢复系统代理 / Pausing Recording does not restore the system proxy
用户操作：同一真实Main并发接收两个Enable，冲突请求必须立即结束而不是排队。 / User actions: send two concurrent Enable calls to the same real Main; a conflicting call must finish without queuing.
结束前通过Restore恢复原系统路由 / Restore the original system route at the end

workflows.testName: settings.upstream applies shared Manual PAC and Direct routes and reloads the saved mode

steps.title: 准备：真实App已启动，fixture拥有回环源站、上游和PAC，不写产品配置文件。 / Arrange: the real App is running; the fixture owns loopback origin, proxy and PAC without seeding product settings.
选择Direct草稿但尚未应用 / Select a Direct draft without applying it
Discard后仍使用System路线 / Retain the System route after Discard
填写真实Manual上游的Host和Port / Enter the actual Manual upstream Host and Port
放弃Manual草稿，当前System路线不变 / Discard the Manual draft without changing the System route
用户操作：草稿取消不改路线；Manual通过两个入口共用的Apply生效。 / User actions: cancelling a draft keeps the route; Manual is applied through the shared settings operation.
查看实际通过Manual上游的请求 / Inspect the request sent through the Manual upstream
从Capture打开当前Manual快捷设置 / Open the current Manual route from Capture
填写快捷PAC草稿，可取消而不改变Manual路线 / Enter a PAC shortcut draft that can be cancelled without changing Manual
取消后重新打开快捷设置，仍为Manual / Reopen the shortcut after cancellation and retain Manual
填写PAC草稿并找到Open in Settings / Enter a PAC draft and locate Open in Settings
Settings保留同一PAC草稿，当前路线尚未改变 / Settings retains the same PAC draft without changing the active route
在Settings放弃PAC草稿，保留Manual路线 / Discard the PAC draft in Settings and retain Manual
Apply后Current route显示PAC / Current route shows PAC after Apply
查看PAC选择PROXY的请求 / Inspect the request for which PAC selects PROXY
查看PAC选择DIRECT的localhost请求 / Inspect the localhost request for which PAC selects DIRECT
选择Direct并准备应用 / Select Direct before applying the route
业务断言：实际连接经过上游，PAC分别选择代理和DIRECT，不以按钮文案代替网络结果。 / Business assertions: real traffic crosses the proxy; PAC selects proxy and DIRECT independently of UI labels.
保存Direct路线后正常关闭App / Close the App normally after saving the Direct route
真实重启后保留Direct路线 / Retain the Direct route after a real restart
需要恢复原出口时选择System并Apply / Select System and Apply to return to the original upstream settings
确认Current route已经回到System / Confirm Current route has returned to System
